profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer | Computer Engineering Graduate | Veteran
profile.geoLocationName: Rapid City, South Dakota, United States
profile.summary:
I am a Computer Engineering graduate with a minor in Mathematics and over eight years of experience working with high reliability systems through my prior service as a Navy Nuclear Mechanic. That background shaped the way I approach engineering: disciplined, detail-oriented, systems-focused, and comfortable working in environments where reliability matters.
I’m currently working as an Embedded Software Engineer Intern, where I’m gaining hands-on experience in embedded software development, Agile engineering workflows, debugging, and hardware-software integration. My role also includes frontend and backend development, giving me broader exposure to how embedded systems connect with supporting applications, tools, interfaces, and data-driven workflows.
Previously, I interned at Phase Technologies, where I supported the development and testing of power electronics hardware, worked with Altium for PCB design, and helped validate new components. That experience strengthened my interest in embedded systems, PCB design, firmware-adjacent development, and hands-on engineering test work.
My technical interests include embedded software, hardware R&D, signal processing, power electronics, and systems where low-level software interacts directly with physical hardware. I’m focused on continuing to grow as an engineer and contributing to reliable, well-designed systems as part of a strong technical team.
